summary: Frontend code review of 3 bug fixes in NovaClinicsPro React Native/Expo app. All 3 bugs verified as CORRECTLY FIXED through code review. TypeScript compilation passes for the relevant files.

bug_1_reschedule_api_422_error.details: rescheduleAppointmentApi now ensures appointment_start field is included in payload by transforming the request: `appointment_start: payload.new_start || payload.appointment_start`. The mutation hook in appointments.repository.impl.ts also includes appointment_start when called (line 333).
bug_1_reschedule_api_422_error.root_cause: Backend expected appointment_start field but frontend was only sending new_start

bug_2_i18n_unresolved_variables.details: All required translation keys are properly defined: appointments.confirmNoShow = 'Are you sure the patient did not show up?', appointments.confirmComplete = 'Mark this appointment as completed?', appointments.confirmReschedule = 'Open reschedule options for this appointment?'
bug_2_i18n_unresolved_variables.root_cause: Translation keys were missing from en-US.json

bug_3_complete_tick_icon_missing.details: CompleteTickIcon component implemented with: (1) Press state for color change (isPressed state), (2) Visibility for confirmed/in_progress appointments (canComplete condition), (3) Confirmation dialog with proper i18n text, (4) data-testid='action-complete-tick' for testing
bug_3_complete_tick_icon_missing.root_cause: Complete button was missing from appointment cards

reschedule_api_payload.verified_in_api: appointments.api.ts transforms payload to include appointment_start
reschedule_api_payload.verified_in_mutation: appointments.repository.impl.ts line 333: { new_start: newStart, appointment_start: newStart }
reschedule_api_payload.verified_in_dto: AppointmentReschedule interface includes both new_start and appointment_start fields

i18n_translations.fallback_mechanism: i18n.ts has proper fallback to key if translation not found

typescript_compilation.notes: TypeScript errors exist in other files (TreatmentCreate, InvoiceCreateRequest, ClientCreate, BatchCreateRequest, StaffCreate) but these are unrelated to the 3 bugs being fixed
